subject: health
concept: Designing a simple public health awareness campaign addressing a genuine community health issue
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a campaign outline covering the issue, target audience, and key message
exercise.abstract: Student designs a simple public health awareness campaign, explaining why their message would reach the intended audience

assessment.mastery_threshold: campaign has a clear issue, audience, and message that logically connect
misconception_flags: campaign message has no clear connection to the stated issue or intended audience

interest_binding: issue generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
